preconditions.expression: root is None or (hasattr(root, 'data') and hasattr(root, 'left') and hasattr(root, 'right'))
preconditions.description: The root parameter is either None or a valid tree node with data, left, and right attributes.
If root exists, its data value is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: root is None or (root.left is None or (hasattr(root.left, 'data') and hasattr(root.left, 'left') and hasattr(root.left, 'right')) and (root.right is None or (hasattr(root.right, 'data') and hasattr(root.right, 'left') and hasattr(root.right, 'right')))
preconditions.description: All child nodes in the tree follow the same valid node structure as the root.

postconditions.description: The returned sum is a non-negative integer modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: return_value == (sum((node.data * mirror_node.data) for node, mirror_node in mirror_pairs(root)) % (10**9 + 7))
postconditions.description: The result equals the sum of products of each node and its mirror image, where each pair is counted exactly once, computed modulo 10^9 + 7.
